topic: Command surfacing review pass five - kill-switch-cli lineage (advisor kill switch, direct-call switch, CLI, launcher allowlist, docs and tests)

noveltyJustification: First pass covers the switch paths; the candidate workspace-root bypass was disproved at the CLI schema boundary, so no finding is new and none is inflated.

findingDetails.case: An operator with MK_HOOKS_DISABLED=1 exported reads the table, believes the name is inert, and expects hooks to run; the resolver disables every concern and names SYSTEM_HOOKS_DISABLED in the reason.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n "MASTER_ALIASES|MK_HOOKS_DISABLED" .skilled/hooks finds the constant, the master loop and the env bridge; the same alias-column drift is in ENV-REFERENCE.md:75 and .skilled/hooks/README.md:44.
findingDetails.title: The master-switch row says No aliases while the resolver honors MK_HOOKS_DISABLED

findingDetails.case: A maintainer who changes where the direct call reads the switch greps the two listed sources, edits the hook and the plugin, and leaves the CLI and daemon readers on the old behavior.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n "disabledRecommendOutput|advisorDisabledBy" .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime finds exactly the CLI and daemon readers plus the shared builder; none is named in the row Source column.
findingDetails.title: The advisor switch row Source column omits the direct-call readers it claims

findingDetails.case: An operator whose shell exports SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_PLUGIN_DISABLED=1 runs CP-003 as written; the control call also abstains, so the operator reads it as the switch reaching the daemon and blocks a release.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The resolver honors ten skill-advisor switch names; the control command unsets four. Observed read-only on the built CLI under SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_PLUGIN_DISABLED=1: recommendations [], abstain Skill advisor disabled by SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_PLUGIN_DISABLED.
findingDetails.title: CP-003 control call can abstain under a switch alias it never unsets

findingDetails.case: A future change adds SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DISABLED or SYSTEM_HOOKS_DISABLED to CHILD_ENV_ALLOWLIST; the test still passes because it never sets those names, and every later caller is silenced by the daemon environment.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The fixture sets only SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_HOOK_DISABLED and SPECKIT_SKILL_ADVISOR_HOOK_DISABLED; ADVISOR_DISABLED_FLAGS has ten names and the CLI test covers the client boundary, not the launcher boundary.
findingDetails.title: Launcher test covers two of the ten switch names it claims to keep out of the daemon env

findingDetails.case: A change to env-aliases.cjs or the legacy alias list drops the MK_ bridge for the direct call; every test passes because the three MK_ names are filtered out of the only CLI loop that drives each alias.
findingDetails.scopeProof: ADVISOR_DISABLED_FLAGS includes three MK_ names; the loop excludes every MK_ name; advisor-disabled.vitest.ts covers only two SYSTEM_/SPECKIT_ names; no test sets an MK_ name and asserts the CLI abstains.
findingDetails.title: CLI disable loop filters out every MK_ alias, so the direct-call path never exercises those names

findingDetails.case: A maintainer uses the tree to see what exists and misses compiled-routing-flag.ts and private-skill-target.ts; the key-files table names df-idf.ts, route-exclusions.ts and caller-context.ts but the tree does not, so the two sections disagree with each other and with the directory.
findingDetails.scopeProof: ls runtime/lib/*.ts returns caller-context.ts, compiled-routing-flag.ts, df-idf.ts, private-skill-target.ts and route-exclusions.ts; the tree lists none of the five and the key-files table lists three.
findingDetails.title: lib README tree omits five flat modules that exist on disk
